description: This file implements the DatabaseConnection class, which manages database connections, executes queries, retrieves results, and handles database callbacks within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and processing query results, with thread safety via mutex locking.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle, query execution, and result processing within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database, opening or creating it with read-write privileges.

methods.name: DisConnect
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database without expecting results.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the number of affected rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the result set into a DatabaseTable.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback for executing queries that do not return results.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback for retrieving query results into a DatabaseTable.
